notes.title: Our First Featured Article!
notes.content: [p]Hi everybody![/p][p]We're super excited to share the first article in which [i]Cecil Hollow[/i] is featured. That might not seem like a big deal to you - but it's [i]huge[/i] for us! As a small independent developer, the biggest hurdle aside from funding is simply getting eyes on your game. Every post, article, tweet, share, etc. helps us.[/p][p]An enormous thanks to Paula Vaynshteyn for including us in her article.[/p][p]It features 9 other indie horror games that you also might be interested in! [/p][p]Read it here: [url="https://thenerdytype.com/2025/07/12/10-creepy-indie-horror-games-that-will-have-you-on-the-edge-of-your-seat/"]10 Creepy Indie Horror Games That Will Have You On The Edge Of Your Seat[/url][/p][p]Love y'all.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 01
notes.content: [h1]We Updated the Demo![/h1][p]A bit delayed, but we published the first update for the demo today! [/p][p]It's a small download (roughly 150mb). [/p][p]Here's what's changed:[/p][list][*][p]Cut the amount of battery drained per second while using the flashlight in half. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the Pause menu didn't function properly after interacting with the workbench[/p][/*][*][p]Added QoL tips for using interior lights when possible and that it's currently [i]expected[/i] for the wheel to freeze during the loading screen.[/p][/*][/list][p]These changes were made based upon player feedback. [b]Do keep the feedback coming[/b]! We'll continue to adjust the demo based upon your experiences and it'll also help us make the full game even better.[/p][h2]We appreciate you.[/h2][h3]Tell your friends about the game. We need your help getting the word out![/h3][p]Immortal, Inc.[/p][p](Justin)[/p]

notes.title: Cecil Hollow - Free Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Cecil Hollow[/h1]
[h2]Free Demo Available Now![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197217/dff1ff8271695be9c4cd9ea1a524a270cf6fcff2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Average Time to Completion: 30 - 60 minutes
[*] Genre: Adventure/Horror
[*] Number of Players: 1
[*] Platform: PC/Steam
[*] Can Players Stream/Record: Yes
[/list]

Cecil Hollow is an adventure horror game set on a remote Appalachian farm in which players are tasked with investigating anomalous phenomena. Could it be the result of aliens, paranormal activity, humans, or something else entirely? Experience this promising title for yourself by playing the new demo today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197217/97e8b1cd24cae4bdefe61a39c1d6a6efb39c7e21.png[/img]

There has never been a more important time to learn about the UAP topic. The U.S. government has officially declared that UAP (AKA UFOs) are real. In the past two years, the U.S. Congress has had hearings featuring whistleblowers with explosive claims. There’ve also been “drone” incursions over U.S. Air Force bases in recent days and weeks with no explanation or identification. What are these things? And what does it all mean for humanity?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197217/3c5bf89bb7f732cba7a12fb84ed64f07373f2cec.png[/img]

The full game will feature more than one ending which will be determined by the player’s investigation and the release date is yet to be announced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197217/443bd2eb4fa0a187cc14e90ee33138588f7136c9.png[/img]

Cecil Hollow is being developed by Immortal - a small startup studio based in Kentucky.

notes.title: New Cecil Hollow Lore Video - Something's Not Right Out Here
notes.content:
We've released the first of a series of videos which will dive into the lore of the world of Cecil Hollow. This one features an audio log from Bobby - a former groundskeeper on the farm. And I don't know about you, but it sounds like he's seen some things...

After checking out the video, please give us a wishlist on Steam! It really helps with the algorithms and lets us know that you're digging what we're doing. Also, feel free to follow us on any of the socials listed below!

Here's the video:

[previewyoutube=dWyOSzcUp3c;full][/previewyoutube]
Cecil Hollow is a short, narrative-driven, sci-fi horror game set in modern-day Kentucky. Explore a remote, deserted farm and attempt to get to the bottom of a decades-long mystery using state-of-the-art tools and technology. Search everywhere for clues. Are extraterrestrials to blame? Are we witnessing top-secret military tech? Are the stories simply made up? Or is it something else entirely? Your investigation can lead to different conclusions - be thorough.

The anomaly doesn't want its origins to be discovered. You will be hindered at nearly every turn. You will be disoriented and tormented. Will you have the guile to finish the investigation?

Cecil Hollow is inspired by true events.

The game draws inspiration from classics such as Silent Hill, Resident Evil, P.T., Gone Home, the film Signs, and many others. It also draws inspiration from real-world strange places like Utah’s Skinwalker Ranch and the current UFO disclosure movement.

notes.title: Crash Retrievals, Alien Tech, Bodies, And More Recovered at Cecil Hollow
notes.content:
"James" makes his second appearance and solidifies himself as an important voice within the UFO Disclosure movement. In this video he tells us about some of his experiences recovering alien artifacts while working for a classified group within the US Department of Energy. 

He talks about possible UFO craft (UAPs), pieces or materials from off-world origins, and what he calls "pilots." 

He also claims that some materials recovered from the famed Roswell crash incident in 1947 led to several technological advancements that we enjoy today. 

We also have a rather rude intrusion by a hater, but he kind of gets what's coming to him.

[previewyoutube=NNT8Kh_z854;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

----------

Cecil Hollow is a short, narrative-driven, sci-fi horror game set in modern-day Kentucky. Explore a remote, deserted farm and attempt to get to the bottom of a decades-long mystery using state-of-the-art tools and technology. Search everywhere for clues. Are extraterrestrials to blame? Are we witnessing top-secret military tech? Are the stories simply made up? Or is it something else entirely? Your investigation can lead to different conclusions - be thorough.

Are the strange events due to extraterrestrials, inter-dimensional beings, or something even darker? Investigate and decide for yourself.

Cecil Hollow is inspired by games such as Silent Hill, Resident Evil, P.T., and more! If you like the vibe of the movie, Signs, starring Mel Gibson and Juaquin Phoenix, you will love the setting of this game! 

More recent similar games include titles such as Content Warning, Phasmophobia, Outlast, Lethal Company, Visage, Amnesia, and The Mortuary's Assistant.

Cecil Hollow will be featured in Steam Next Fest from June 10th-17th.
